integrity.computation: Finite reproducibility script checks all cycle types for n=4 through n=7; not a substitute for the all-size argument.
integrity.earliest_source_date_explanation: 2010-03-29 is the original dated arXiv posting of the relevant earlier equivariant Kneser-graph investigation; the direct nonequivariant family theorem was publicly posted in 2018.
integrity.proof: symbolic augmented Lefschetz orbit count and Boolean-cycle inversion; classical rational symmetric-group representation theory

scientific_limitations: Only rational equivariant homology is classified; no integral group-ring lattice or equivariant homotopy type is claimed.
The known non-equivariant homotopy theorem of Nilakantan and Singh is used to identify the unique nonzero degree.
The previously published six-point representation is credited and excluded from the new n>=7 domain.
Bibliographic completeness and independent validation are not asserted.
title: Uniform symmetric-group characters of Kneser neighborhood homology
